eval_feedback: Zero false positives; all five decoys explicitly cleared, D3 with a correct justification (axis-of-change, not size).

The single miss, F13, is an inverted call: the review noticed the facade/aggregate type cycle and declared it fine because type-only imports are erased at compile time - the exact rationalisation the answer key says lets the cycle survive review.
